test_title: PYST 31: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02c3634684e4ae5d9a108294f00bd0f0dbab2ecd53b63e3d68c2f79a3adafee9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The 2nd column elements shift anticlockwise in the downward direction.

The elements at the corners interchange positions diagonally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95fc89c68eabaa022ab9725f6933e4ab3b12d267dc2981ed6271372819d31f43.png] 

2) Second box series →

The 1st column and center elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22f7201cdaafcf518e2c0327dda63e17dd53a820ae19aeb7ac7c9f2d00eb6be1.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94bc8368fe83fca401f236f2ec92f11b952bfee54405d07afe00f6f48148866a.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
